        15                  THE SECRETARY:    By Senator Bruno,

        16       Legislative Resolution Number 498,

        17       memorializing Governor George E. Pataki to

        18       proclaim February 20 through 26, 2005, as

        19       Eating Disorders Awareness Week in the State

        20       of New York.

        21                  ACTING PRESIDENT FUSCHILLO:

        22       Senator Bruno.

        23                  SENATOR BRUNO:    Thank you, Mr.

        24       President and colleagues.

        25                  The resolution that's before us



                      Candyco Transcription Service, Inc.
                                (518) 371-8910
                                                        695



         1       really is intended to help highlight and call

         2       to our attention, and the people of New York,

         3       that next week is Eating Disorders Awareness

         4       Week.  And a lot of people in this state and

         5       in this country don't fully appreciate what

         6       anorexia, bulimia, binge eating represents.

         7                  There probably isn't a person that

         8       doesn't know someone personally that doesn't

         9       suffer from an eating disorder of some type.

        10                  And the statistics are sad.

        11       Probably one of the best known that died from

        12       anorexia, bulimia, in her early 30s, Karen

        13       Carpenter.  Mary Kate Olsen, a beautiful young

        14       lady, suffering from anorexia.

        15                  Movie stars are out there and they

        16       personify, in the eyes of a lot of adolescents

        17       and adults, beauty.  Many of them suffer from

        18       serious eating disorders.  One out of 10

        19       people that have an eating disorder are

        20       treated for it.

        21                  Now, what people -- people hide it.

        22       I know families that are embarrassed that

        23       their daughters have anorexia or bulimia or

        24       binge eat with bulimia.  Do you know what?

        25       People die, young people die from these eating



                      Candyco Transcription Service, Inc.
                                (518) 371-8910
                                                        696



         1       disorders.

         2                  Now, we had Jenny Lauren in the

         3       chamber here, I believe last May.  We passed a

         4       bill with your help, and the Assembly, and the

         5       Governor signed it, to create three centers,

         6       pilot centers here in this state to treat,

         7       primarily, anorexia and bulimia and binge

         8       eating.

         9                  Jenny Lauren almost died.  And she

        10       wrote a book.  And I just respect her and

        11       others like her when you meet and talk with

        12       them.  She has put her life back together.

        13                  But in her book, which is very --

        14       in a lot of places pretty difficult to read,

        15       because what happens -- and by the way, I see

        16       young people here in the chamber, and it's

        17       great to see them here.  Eighty percent --

        18       think of this -- of 13-year-olds admit, when

        19       they survey, that they diet.

        20                  Dieting is a great fad, and

        21       necessary for some people to maintain good

        22       health.  But for young people, 90 percent of

        23       the people that suffer in a serious way --

        24       harm their bodies, a third never get cured --

        25       are adolescents, young women primarily.  Young



                      Candyco Transcription Service, Inc.
                                (518) 371-8910
                                                        697



         1       women.

         2                  So this may appear to some to be

         3       casual.  It is not casual.  If you know anyone

         4       who has a child or an adult in their family

         5       with an eating -- a serious, serious eating

         6       disorder, some of them are suicidal.  And too

         7       many people die.

         8                  I visited with a mother who travels

         9       the country, from the western part of the

        10       country.  Her 19-year-old daughter died.

        11       Couldn't -- couldn't help her, couldn't do

        12       anything about it.  Watched her die.

        13                  When you listen to people like

        14       that, you realize that anything that we can do

        15       to help people understand, help families

        16       understand.  There is more and more treatment.

        17       And when we're successful with these pilots,

        18       there will be comprehensive treatment;

        19       prevention, care and aftercare.

        20                  And I would wager there isn't

        21       anyone here that isn't exposed to someone with

        22       an eating disorder.  And a serious, serious

        23       problem for families.

        24                  So thank you, Mr. President.  Thank

        25       you, our colleagues, for being aware, helping



                      Candyco Transcription Service, Inc.
                                (518) 371-8910
                                                        698



         1       your constituency be aware of this

         2       life-threatening problem here in this state

         3       and in the country.

         4                  Thank you.
